StarlitSteppe_Text_Npc0.en: LARVITAR hides in the tall grass at\nnight.
StarlitSteppe_Text_Npc0.fr: EMBRYLEX se cache dans les hautes\nherbes la nuit.

StarlitSteppe_Text_Npc1.en: Even DUNSPARCE shows up, if you are\nlucky.
StarlitSteppe_Text_Npc1.fr: Même INSOLOURDO se montre, si tu as\nde la chance.

StarlitSteppe_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

StarlitSteppe_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
